signal.instructions: Given this bounded market/on-chain state, classify the directional signal. Prefer uncertain when evidence is weak.

criteria.uncertain: Insufficient or conflicting evidence — abstain from direction

escalate.instructions: Should NorthStar escalate this asset for a full specialist portfolio research run?

criteria.true: Signal is high-value enough to warrant expensive specialist agents
criteria.false: Signal is low-value noise — log and ignore
